AI.result: 中位随访44.7个月（IQR 34.5-49.0），61例（64.2%）检出房颤；Kaplan-Meier累积发生率3个月30%、1年46%、2年58%，中位检出时间124天（IQR 13-385）。房颤组左房容积指数（LAVI）更大（35.2 vs 28.2 mL/m2，p<0.001）、LVEF更低（53.1% vs 59.6%，p<0.001）、心衰发生率更高（p=0.032）。多因素分析显示LAVI（每mL/m2调整OR 1.10，95%CI 1.03-1.17；p=0.006）和LVEF≤50%（调整OR 9.2，95%CI 1.9-44.5；p=0.006）为独立预测因素（AUC 0.79），Cox模型中仍独立（LAVI调整HR 1.04，LVEF≤50%调整HR 2.2，95%CI 1.3-3.9）。LAVI≥26 mL/m2作为排除阈值（敏感性92%），LVEF≤50%作为纳入阈值（特异性94%，PPV 92%）；无单一阈值或组合兼具高敏感性与高特异性。分层分析显示LAVI阈值上下2年累积发生率70% vs 20%（log-rank p<0.001），LVEF阈值上下73% vs 53%（p=0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 房扑消融后连续监测显示约三分之二患者检出新发房颤，常于术后数月出现；左房重构和心室功能不全是独立预测因素，LAVI≥26 mL/m2和LVEF≤50%可作为实用阈值指导延长节律监测和抗凝重启决策。但本研究为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，阈值需外部验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心房扑动和心房颤动（AF）源于共同的心律失常性心房基质，并且在同一患者的生命周期中经常共存。我们旨在探讨在真实世界人群中成功典型心房扑动消融后新发AF的真实发生率及相关危险因素。

方法：我们进行了一项单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2019年至2024年间接受心房扑动消融并植入植入式循环记录仪（ILR）的成人患者，作为系统性消融后监测实践的一部分。从电子病历系统收集人口学和临床变量。采用Cox比例风险模型和多变量logistic回归识别AF的独立预测因素，同时使用Kaplan-Meier法估计AF的累积发生率，并随后推导出临床相关风险阈值。

结果：在95例患者（平均年龄69.5 ± 7.9岁；77.9%男性；平均CHA2DS2-VASc 3.3）中，中位随访44.7个月（IQR 34.5-49.0），61例（64.2%）检测到AF。通过Kaplan-Meier估计，AF的累积发生率在3个月时为30%，1年时为46%，2年时为58%；受影响患者的中位检测时间为124天（IQR 13-385）。检测到AF的患者左心房容积指数（LAVI）较大（35.2 vs. 28.2 mL/m2，p<0.001），LVEF较低（53.1% vs. 59.6%，p<0.001），并且心力衰竭发生率较高（p = 0.032）。LAVI（每mL/m2调整OR 1.10，95% CI 1.03-1.17；p = 0.006）和LVEF降低（≤50%；调整OR 9.2，95% CI 1.9-44.5；p = 0.006）是独立预测因素（AUC 0.79），并且在Cox模型中两者均保持独立（LAVI每mL/m2调整HR 1.04；LVEF ≤50%调整HR 2.2，95% CI 1.3-3.9）。LAVI阈值≥26 mL/m2作为排除标准（敏感性92%），而LVEF ≤50%作为纳入标准（特异性94%，PPV 92%）；没有单一阈值或组合同时达到高敏感性和高特异性。在分层分析中，LAVI阈值上下2年AF累积发生率分别为70%和20%（log-rank p<0.001），LVEF阈值上下分别为73%和53%（p = 0.001）。

结论：消融后连续监测显示，心房扑动消融后约三分之二的患者出现AF，通常在术后数月内出现。更晚期的心房重构和心室功能受损是较高风险的独立预测因素，提供了实用且可及的阈值，以指导临床决策关于哪些患者在心房扑动消融后需要延长节律监测和重新开始抗凝治疗。

title: Conventional Atrioventricular Nodal Reentrant Tachycardia Ablation: 16-Year Acute Outcomes and Pacemaker Requirement.
summary:
BACKGROUND: This study characterized the acute success, causes of failure, and index-hospitalization permanent pacemaker (PPM) rate of conventional (fluoroscopy-guided, without 3D electroanatomic mapping [3D-EAM]) AVNRT ablation over 16 years at a single center.

METHODS: Consecutive adult patients (≥18 years) who underwent conventional ablation for AVNRT between January 2010 and May 2026 were retrospectively evaluated. All procedures were performed by a senior operator or under the direct supervision of a senior operator. Acute success was defined as non-inducibility of AVNRT under isoproterenol. The primary endpoints were index-hospitalization PPM and acute success. Rates are presented with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs).

RESULTS: Of 1169 SVT cases, 814 (69.6%) underwent AVNRT ablation (age 46.9 ± 13.0 years; 67.0% female). Acute success was 90.3% (735/814; 95% CI 88.07-92.14). Causes of failure (n = 79): anatomic limitation 40 (50.6%), persistent inducibility 29 (36.7%), AV conduction disturbance 8 (10.1%), patient intolerance 1, atrial fibrillation 1. Anatomic limitation denotes ablation deliberately terminated to protect AV conduction rather than technical failure. High-grade AV block developed in 8 patients (0.98%); it resolved spontaneously in 5, and a PPM was implanted during the index hospitalization in 3 (0.37%; 95% CI 0.13-1.08). In the three PPM patients, ventricular pacing remained 100% at follow-up. Acute success showed no significant univariable association with age or sex.

CONCLUSIONS: Conventional AVNRT ablation can be performed at an experienced center with high success (90.3%) and a low PPM rate (0.37%). While some AV block events resolved in the laboratory, those that persisted led to a PPM requirement, and AV conduction was not regained in these patients. These findings provide operator-homogeneous real-world reference data from a tertiary referral center in Türkiye.

AI.tldr: 单中心16年814例常规（非三维标测）AVNRT消融，急性成功率90.3%，住院期起搏器植入率仅0.37%，3例起搏器患者随访心室起搏比例均为100%。
AI.motivation: 三维电解剖标测（3D-EAM）已广泛用于心律失常消融，但常规X线透视引导下AVNRT消融在真实世界中的急性成功率、失败原因及起搏器植入风险缺乏长期、操作者同质化的参考数据，尤其缺乏来自非欧美中心的大样本报告。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，连续纳入2010年1月至2026年5月接受常规（透视引导、不使用3D-EAM）AVNRT消融的成人患者（≥18岁），所有手术由资深术者完成或在其直接监督下完成。急性成功定义为异丙肾上腺素激发下AVNRT不可诱发。主要终点为住院期永久起搏器（PPM）植入与急性成功，率以Wilson 95%CI表示；对年龄、性别与急性成功的关系行单因素分析。
AI.result: 共1169例SVT中814例（69.6%）行AVNRT消融，年龄46.9±13.0岁，女性67.0%。急性成功735/814（90.3%，95%CI 88.07–92.14）。失败79例，原因包括解剖限制40例（50.6%，指为保护AV传导而主动终止消融）、持续可诱发29例（36.7%）、AV传导障碍8例（10.1%）、患者不能耐受1例、房颤1例。8例（0.98%）发生高度AV阻滞，其中5例自行恢复，3例（0.37%，95%CI 0.13–1.08）于住院期植入PPM，该3例随访时心室起搏比例均为100%。急性成功与年龄、性别无显著单因素关联。
AI.conclusion: 在经验丰富的中心，常规AVNRT消融可获得90.3%的高急性成功率与0.37%的低起搏器植入率；术中部分AV阻滞可自行恢复，但持续存在的AV阻滞将导致起搏器依赖且AV传导未能恢复。该结果为土耳其三级转诊中心操作者同质化的真实世界参考数据；局限性为单中心回顾性设计、缺乏三维标测对照组及长期随访，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh:
背景：本研究描述了单中心16年间传统（透视引导、不使用三维电解剖标测[3D-EAM]）AVNRT消融的急性成功率、失败原因及住院期间永久起搏器（PPM）植入率。

方法：回顾性评估2010年1月至2026年5月期间因AVNRT接受传统消融的连续成年患者（≥18岁）。所有手术均由资深术者或在其直接监督下完成。急性成功定义为异丙肾上腺素激发下AVNRT不可诱发。主要终点为住院期间PPM植入和急性成功。率以Wilson 95%置信区间（CI）表示。

结果：在1169例SVT病例中，814例（69.6%）接受了AVNRT消融（年龄46.9 ± 13.0岁；67.0%女性）。急性成功率为90.3%（735/814；95% CI 88.07-92.14）。失败原因（n = 79）：解剖限制40例（50.6%）、持续可诱发29例（36.7%）、AV传导障碍8例（10.1%）、患者不耐受1例、心房颤动1例。解剖限制指为保护AV传导而有意终止消融，而非技术失败。8例患者（0.98%）发生高度AV阻滞；其中5例自行恢复，3例（0.37%；95% CI 0.13-1.08）在住院期间植入PPM。在3例PPM患者中，随访时心室起搏比例仍为100%。急性成功与年龄或性别无显著单变量关联。

结论：传统AVNRT消融可在经验丰富的中心进行，成功率高（90.3%），PPM植入率低（0.37%）。虽然部分AV阻滞事件在电生理实验室中恢复，但持续存在者导致PPM需求，且这些患者未恢复AV传导。这些发现提供了来自土耳其三级转诊中心的术者同质化真实世界参考数据。

title: Human Engineered Heart Tissues Reproduce Trigger- and Substrate-Driven Mechanisms of Ventricular Tachycardia.
summary: Human iPSC‑derived engineered heart tissues (EHTs) are used to model cardiac physiology and drug responses, yet whether they reproduce tissue‑scale ventricular arrhythmia mechanisms remains unclear. We combined modified milliPillar EHT fabrication with high-resolution dual-channel voltage/Ca2+ optical mapping. Baseline electrophysiology showed action potential durations (APD) within the range reported for human ventricles and conduction velocities approximately half of human longitudinal values, with rate‑dependent restitution of APD and Ca2+ transient duration, conduction slowing, and physiologic AP-Ca2+ latency. To interrogate a trigger arm of ventricular tachycardia (VT), we modeled acquired long-QT syndrome (aLQTS; hERG blockade with hypokalemia/hypomagnesemia) in EHTs from two hiPSC lines. aLQTS EHTs developed VT-like episodes with beat‑to‑beat instability. Early afterdepolarizations propagated heterogeneously, generating triggered activity, tissue acceleration, APD dispersion, wavebreak, and rotor formation. These were short and self-terminating (median 0.4 s) and clustered at head/neck region curvatures. To test whether a fixed spatial substrate supports prolonged reentry, we developed a reproducible focal cryoinjury model. After injury, all tissues developed VT-like episodes, and 70% anatomically anchored rotors at the border; three persisted beyond 10 s, a recording-limited lower bound. Dual voltage/Ca2+ mapping at this resolution establishes EHTs as a non-animal platform for mechanistic study of both trigger- and substrate-driven ventricular arrhythmias.

AI.tldr: 人iPSC来源工程化心脏组织可重现触发与基质驱动的室性心动过速机制，表现为早期后除极诱发的自限性VT样事件及冷冻损伤后边界锚定的持续性转子。
AI.motivation: 人iPSC来源工程化心脏组织（EHT）已用于心脏生理和药物反应建模，但其能否重现组织水平的室性心律失常机制尚不明确，缺乏非动物平台进行机制研究。
AI.method: 研究采用改良milliPillar EHT制备结合高分辨率双通道电压/Ca2+光学标测。基线电生理评估动作电位时程（APD）、传导速度及频率依赖性恢复。通过hERG阻断联合低钾/低镁在两种hiPSC系EHT中模拟获得性长QT综合征（aLQTS）以研究触发机制；通过可重复局灶冷冻损伤模型研究固定空间基质对持续性折返的支持。终点包括VT样事件、早期后除极、转子形成及持续时间。
AI.result: 基线APD在人类心室报道范围内，传导速度约为人类纵向值的一半，APD和Ca2+瞬变时长呈频率依赖性恢复，传导减慢，AP-Ca2+潜伏期生理性。aLQTS EHT出现VT样事件伴逐搏不稳定，早期后除极异质性传播，产生触发活动、组织加速、APD离散、波裂和转子形成；事件短暂自终止（中位0.4秒）， clustered at head/neck region curvatures。冷冻损伤后所有组织出现VT样事件，70%在边界形成解剖锚定转子，3个持续超过10秒（记录限制下限）。
AI.conclusion: EHT结合双电压/Ca2+标测可作为非动物平台研究触发和基质驱动的室性心律失常机制，但VT样事件多为自限性，持续性转子受记录时间限制，需进一步验证其与临床VT机制的对应关系。

summary_zh: 人iPSC来源的工程化心脏组织（EHT）被用于模拟心脏生理学和药物反应，但其是否能重现组织尺度的心室心律失常机制仍不清楚。我们将改良的milliPillar EHT制备与高分辨率双通道电压/Ca2+光学标测相结合。基线电生理显示动作电位时程（APD）处于已报道的人心室范围内，传导速度约为人类纵向值的一半，并具有APD和Ca2+瞬变时程的频率依赖性恢复、传导减慢以及生理性AP-Ca2+潜伏期。为了探究室性心动过速（VT）的触发机制，我们在来自两个hiPSC系的EHT中模拟了获得性长QT综合征（aLQTS；hERG阻断伴低钾血症/低镁血症）。aLQTS EHT出现了具有逐搏不稳定性的VT样发作。早期后除极不均匀传播，产生触发活动、组织加速、APD离散、波破碎和转子形成。这些发作短暂且自行终止（中位数0.4秒），并聚集在头/颈区域曲率处。为了测试固定的空间基质是否支持延长的折返，我们开发了可重复的局灶冷冻损伤模型。损伤后，所有组织均出现VT样发作，70%在边界处形成解剖锚定的转子；三个持续超过10秒，这是记录限制的下限。在此分辨率下的双电压/Ca2+标测使EHT成为用于触发驱动和基质驱动的心室心律失常机制研究的非动物平台。

title: A Conceptual Translational Bench-to-Bedside Cardiac Safety Framework for Predicting Drug-Induced QT Interval Prolongation from Molecular Structure to Clinical Data.
summary: QT interval prolongation is associated with an increased risk of torsades de pointes (TdP), a potentially life-threatening ventricular arrhythmia, making assessment of cardiac repolarization a critical component of drug development. This work demonstrates how integrated in silico methodologies can be used to predict and quantitatively characterize QT liability across the drug discovery and development continuum. A proof-of concept translational workflow combining molecular structure analysis, in vitro pharmacology, animal data, and clinical exposure-response modeling was evaluated using the retrospective case examples verapamil and dofetilide. Molecular structure- and pharmacology-based assessments predicted hERG channel interaction and potential QT risk for both compounds. While initial in silico analyses suggested a high QT liability for verapamil and dofetilide, mechanistic electrophysiological modeling differentiated their effects. For verapamil, concurrent calcium channel inhibition offset hERG-mediated effects, resulting in predicted reductions in action potential duration and no clinically relevant QT prolongation. In contrast, dofetilide produced concentration-dependent increases in action potential duration, consistent with its known proarrhythmic potential. Translation of nonclinical findings to humans accurately predicted the absence of clinically meaningful QT effects for verapamil and identified QT prolongation exceeding the regulatory 10 ms threshold for dofetilide at therapeutic concentrations. Drug exposure and pharmacokinetic properties could be anticipated based solely on molecular structure. This conceptual workflow demonstrates how integrated quantitative in silico approaches can support earlier identification, characterization, and communication of QT risk, enabling informed decision-making and improved development efficiency from bench to bedside.

AI.tldr: 概念性转化工作流整合分子结构、体外药理、动物数据和临床暴露-反应模型，回顾性分析维拉帕米和多非利特，成功预测维拉帕米无临床相关QT延长、多非利特治疗浓度下QT延长超过10 ms阈值。
AI.motivation: QT间期延长增加尖端扭转型室速（TdP）风险，是药物研发中心脏复极评估的关键环节。既往依赖单一非临床或临床方法，缺乏从分子结构到临床数据的整合定量预测框架，导致QT风险识别滞后、研发效率受限。
AI.method: 概念验证性转化研究，采用回顾性案例（维拉帕米和多非利特），整合分子结构分析、体外药理学、动物数据和临床暴露-反应建模的计算机模拟工作流。主要评估hERG通道相互作用、动作电位时程（APD）变化及临床QT延长是否超过监管10 ms阈值。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 基于分子结构和药理学的评估预测两种化合物均与hERG通道相互作用并存在QT风险。机制性电生理建模区分了二者效应：维拉帕米因钙通道抑制抵消hERG介导效应，预测APD缩短且无临床相关QT延长；多非利特呈浓度依赖性APD增加，治疗浓度下QT延长超过监管10 ms阈值。非临床结果转化至人体准确预测了上述临床结局。药物暴露和药代动力学特性可仅基于分子结构预测。
AI.conclusion: 该概念性工作流表明，整合定量计算机模拟方法可在药物研发早期识别、表征和沟通QT风险，支持从基础到临床的知情决策并提高研发效率。但研究仅为回顾性概念验证，样本量小（2例），需前瞻性验证；摘要未报告具体效应量、置信区间和P值，临床推广前需进一步确认模型稳健性。

summary_zh: QT间期延长与尖端扭转型室性心动过速（TdP）风险增加相关，TdP是一种可能危及生命的室性心律失常，因此评估心脏复极是药物开发的关键组成部分。本研究展示了如何应用整合的计算机模拟方法在药物发现和开发全过程中预测和定量表征QT风险。使用回顾性案例维拉帕米和多非利特评估了一种概念验证的转化工作流程，该流程结合了分子结构分析、体外药理学、动物数据和临床暴露-反应建模。基于分子结构和药理学的评估预测了两种化合物的hERG通道相互作用和潜在QT风险。虽然初步的计算机模拟分析提示维拉帕米和多非利特具有高QT风险，但机制性电生理建模区分了它们的作用。对于维拉帕米，同时抑制钙通道抵消了hERG介导的作用，导致预测的动作电位时程缩短且无临床相关的QT延长。相反，多非利特产生浓度依赖性的动作电位时程增加，与其已知的致心律失常潜力一致。将非临床发现转化到人体准确预测了维拉帕米无临床意义的QT效应，并确定了多非利特在治疗浓度下QT延长超过监管10 ms阈值。药物暴露和药代动力学特性可以仅基于分子结构进行预测。这一概念性工作流程展示了整合的定量计算机模拟方法如何支持QT风险的早期识别、表征和沟通，从而实现从实验室到临床的知情决策和开发效率的提高。

title: Frontiers in the Risk Stratification and Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Arrest and Death in Athletes.
summary: Background: Sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) and sudden cardiac death (SCD) remain the leading causes of exercise-related mortality in athletes. Research in recent years has produced substantial advances in the understanding of athlete-specific risk, the etiologic spectrum of SCA/SCD, and the tools available for screening and risk stratification. Methods: We performed a narrative review of the literature identified through PubMed/MEDLINE searches of related terms, supplemented by targeted searches and reference checking. Summary of the Review: In this narrative review, we synthesize updated evidence on the epidemiology, etiologies, screening, and emerging technologies relevant to SCA/SCD in athletes. Conclusions: Contemporary evaluation of SCA/SCD risk in athletes relies on multimodal, individualized assessment with longitudinal surveillance and shared decision-making. Emerging computational tools may further refine risk prediction, but current evidence remains limited.

AI.tldr: 本综述指出，运动员SCA/SCD风险评估需采用多模态个体化评估、纵向监测与共享决策，新兴计算工具证据尚有限。
AI.motivation: SCA/SCD是运动员运动相关死亡的首要原因；近年对运动员特异性风险、SCA/SCD病因谱及筛查与风险分层工具的认识有较大进展，但缺乏系统整合，临床亟需明确现有证据边界与评估路径。
AI.method: 叙述性综述。通过PubMed/MEDLINE检索相关术语，并辅以定向检索与参考文献追溯获取文献；无预设样本量、干预措施或定量终点，未报告系统评价或荟萃分析的统计方法。
AI.result: 综述汇总了运动员SCA/SCD的流行病学、病因、筛查及新兴技术证据；摘要未报告具体发病率、病因构成比、筛查阳性率或效应量及95%CI、P值等定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 当代运动员SCA/SCD风险评估依赖多模态、个体化评估，结合纵向监测与共享决策；新兴计算工具可能进一步优化风险预测，但当前证据仍有限。对电生理实践而言，提示应将个体化筛查与长期随访纳入运动员管理路径，但本综述为叙述性，未提供可直接改变指南的定量证据。

summary_zh: 背景：心脏骤停（SCA）和心脏性猝死（SCD）仍然是运动员运动相关死亡的主要原因。近年来的研究在理解运动员特异性风险、SCA/SCD的病因谱以及可用于筛查和风险分层的工具方面取得了实质性进展。方法：我们对通过PubMed/MEDLINE检索相关术语所识别的文献进行了叙述性综述，并辅以针对性检索和参考文献核查。综述总结：在这篇叙述性综述中，我们综合了关于运动员SCA/SCD的流行病学、病因、筛查和新兴技术的更新证据。结论：当代对运动员SCA/SCD风险的评估依赖于多模式、个体化评估，并结合纵向监测和共享决策。新兴的计算工具可能进一步改进风险预测，但当前证据仍然有限。

title: Case Report: Sepsis With Multisystemic Amyloid Light-Chain Amyloidosis.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Systemic light-chain (AL) amyloidosis is a complex disorder characterized by extracellular fibril deposition, leading to severe multisystem dysfunction. When sepsis superimposes on preexisting organ impairment, early clinical recognition becomes particularly challenging yet critical.

METHODS: We present a case of a 60-year-old female who presented with generalized edema, dyspnea, and cardiac/renal involvement, subsequently diagnosed with AL amyloidosis based on laboratory, imaging, bone marrow biopsy, and Congo red staining findings.

RESULTS: Following chemotherapy with bortezomib and cyclophosphamide, the patient experienced transient cardiac arrest, received an implantable cardioverter defibrillator, and subsequently developed massive ascites. Upon developing Pseudomonas guariconensis bacteremia, she progressed to septic shock requiring intensive care unit admission, mechanical ventilation, vasopressor support, and targeted antimicrobial therapy. Through aggressive supportive care and source control, hemodynamic stabilization was achieved, allowing successful extubation and transfer to the general ward.

CONCLUSIONS: Superimposed sepsis on severe, multi-organ amyloidosis significantly complicates diagnosis and management. High clinical vigilance, early infection recognition, and prompt targeted therapy are essential to prevent fatal outcomes in patients with preexisting chronic organ dysfunctions.

AI.tldr: 一例60岁女性AL型淀粉样变性多器官受累患者，化疗后发生心脏骤停并植入ICD，继发铜绿假单胞菌血流感染导致脓毒性休克，经积极支持治疗和感染源控制后血流动力学稳定并成功脱机。
AI.motivation: 系统性轻链（AL）淀粉样变性因细胞外纤维沉积导致多器官功能障碍，当脓毒症叠加于既存器官损害时，早期识别极为困难但至关重要。既往文献对这类复杂病例的诊治经验有限，需提高临床警惕性。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为60岁女性，表现为全身水肿、呼吸困难及心脏/肾脏受累，经实验室、影像学、骨髓活检和刚果红染色确诊AL淀粉样变性。干预包括硼替佐米和环磷酰胺化疗，后续出现短暂心脏骤停并植入ICD，后发生大量腹水及铜绿假单胞菌血流感染。终点为临床过程描述，无统计方法。
AI.result: 患者化疗后出现短暂心脏骤停并植入ICD，随后发生大量腹水。在检出铜绿假单胞菌血流感染后进展为脓毒性休克，需ICU收治、机械通气、血管升压药支持和目标性抗菌治疗。经积极支持治疗和感染源控制，血流动力学稳定，成功拔管并转至普通病房。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 严重多器官淀粉样变性患者叠加脓毒症会显著增加诊断和管理难度。对于既存慢性器官功能障碍的患者，高度临床警惕、早期识别感染并及时目标性治疗对防止致命结局至关重要。本病例提示电生理医生在植入ICD后需关注感染风险，但单例报告局限性明显。

summary_zh:
引言：系统性轻链（AL）淀粉样变性是一种复杂的疾病，其特征是细胞外纤维沉积，导致严重的多系统功能障碍。当脓毒症叠加在既有的器官损害之上时，早期临床识别变得尤为困难，但也至关重要。

方法：我们报告一例60岁女性，表现为全身性水肿、呼吸困难以及心脏/肾脏受累，随后根据实验室检查、影像学、骨髓活检和刚果红染色结果被诊断为AL淀粉样变性。

结果：在接受硼替佐米和环磷酰胺化疗后，患者经历了短暂性心脏骤停，接受了植入式心律转复除颤器，随后出现大量腹水。在发生Pseudomonas guariconensis菌血症后，她进展为脓毒性休克，需要入住重症监护病房、机械通气、血管升压药支持和针对性抗菌治疗。通过积极的支持性治疗和感染源控制，血流动力学稳定得以实现，从而成功拔管并转入普通病房。

结论：在严重的多器官淀粉样变性基础上叠加脓毒症，显著增加了诊断和管理的复杂性。高度的临床警惕性、早期识别感染以及及时的目标性治疗，对于防止存在慢性器官功能障碍的患者发生致命结局至关重要。

title: Prognostic Value of the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio in Patients Hospitalized with Atrioventricular Block: Association with In-Hospital Mortality and Temporary Pacemaker Requirement.
summary: Background and Objectives: The C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR) is an available marker of inflammatory-nutritional vulnerability, but its prognostic value in atrioventricular (AV) block is unclear. We investigated whether CAR is associated with in-hospital mortality and temporary pacemaker requirement (TPR) in hospitalized AV block. Materials and Methods: The study included 698 adults hospitalized with second-degree or higher AV block between January 2012 and July 2020. CAR was calculated from admission C-reactive protein and albumin levels. The primary endpoint was in-hospital mortality, and the secondary endpoint was TPR. Results: In-hospital mortality occurred in 14.5% of patients, and TPR occurred in 33.7%. CAR was higher in non-survivors than survivors (0.51 [0.13-1.85] vs. 0.13 [0.05-0.45], p < 0.001) and in patients with TPR than those without TPR (0.29 [0.09-1.10] vs. 0.13 [0.05-0.41], p < 0.001). Mortality increased across CAR quartiles from 3.8% to 27.7%, and TPR increased from 19.7% to 48.0%. In adjusted models, ln(1 + CAR) was independently associated with mortality (OR 2.14, 95% CI 1.44-3.19; p < 0.001) and TPR (OR 1.99, 95% CI 1.38-2.86; p < 0.001). Adding CAR modestly improved discrimination for mortality (0.751 to 0.782; p = 0.020) and TPR (0.623 to 0.671; p < 0.001), without clear superiority over its individual components. Conclusions: CAR was independently associated with in-hospital mortality and TPR in hospitalized AV block.

AI.tldr: 在698例住院二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者中，C反应蛋白/白蛋白比值（CAR）升高与院内死亡和临时起搏器置入独立相关，但仅轻度提升预测区分度。
AI.motivation: CAR是易获取的炎症-营养状态标志物，但其在房室传导阻滞住院患者中的预后价值尚不明确，既往缺乏针对该人群院内死亡与临时起搏器需求的大样本证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究，纳入2012年1月至2020年7月住院的698例成人二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者，以入院时CRP与白蛋白计算CAR。主要终点为院内死亡，次要终点为临时起搏器置入（TPR）。采用多因素回归分析ln(1+CAR)与终点的独立关联，并以ROC曲线下面积评估增量预测价值。
AI.conclusion: CAR与住院房室传导阻滞患者的院内死亡及临时起搏器置入独立相关，可作为早期风险分层的辅助指标；但其增量预测价值有限，且未优于CRP或白蛋白单独使用，回顾性单中心设计亦限制因果推断，尚需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 背景与目的：C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值（CAR）是一种可用的炎症-营养脆弱性标志物，但其在房室（AV）传导阻滞中的预后价值尚不明确。我们研究了CAR是否与住院AV传导阻滞患者的院内死亡率和临时起搏器需求（TPR）相关。材料与方法：研究纳入2012年1月至2020年7月期间因二度或更高程度AV传导阻滞住院的698例成人患者。CAR由入院时C反应蛋白和白蛋白水平计算得出。主要终点为院内死亡率，次要终点为TPR。结果：院内死亡发生于14.5%的患者，TPR发生于33.7%的患者。CAR在非存活者中高于存活者（0.51 [0.13-1.85] vs. 0.13 [0.05-0.45]，p < 0.001），在需要TPR的患者中高于未需要TPR的患者（0.29 [0.09-1.10] vs. 0.13 [0.05-0.41]，p < 0.001）。死亡率随CAR四分位数增加从3.8%升至27.7%，TPR从19.7%升至48.0%。在调整模型中，ln(1 + CAR)与死亡率（OR 2.14，95% CI 1.44-3.19；p < 0.001）和TPR（OR 1.99，95% CI 1.38-2.86；p < 0.001）独立相关。加入CAR适度改善了死亡率（0.751至0.782；p = 0.020）和TPR（0.623至0.671；p < 0.001）的区分度，但相较于其单独组分未见明显优势。结论：CAR与住院AV传导阻滞患者的院内死亡率和TPR独立相关。

title: Late Obesity-Driven Subcutaneous ICD Geometric Failure: Salvage With Sub-Serratus Generator Repositioning.
summary: S-ICD efficacy depends on extracardiac shock vector geometry. We report late obesity-associated geometric deterioration after substantial weight gain. Rising shock impedance prompted reassessment at generator replacement, revealing pocket dehiscence, adipose interposition, and generator superficialization. Because fibrosis precluded parasternal lead mobilization by simple traction, sub-serratus generator repositioning improved the PRAETORIAN score and shock impedance. Despite a subsequent rise to 130 Ω, defibrillation succeeded with a 65 J shock. S-ICD geometry should be considered dynamic, particularly after major changes in body habitus.

AI.tldr: 一例肥胖患者体重显著增加后出现S-ICD晚期几何失效，通过胸肌下发生器重新定位改善PRAETORIAN评分和除颤阻抗，但阻抗仍升至130Ω，65J除颤成功。
AI.motivation: S-ICD疗效依赖心外除颤向量几何，但既往对体重变化等动态因素对几何长期影响的认识不足，缺乏晚期肥胖相关几何恶化的处理经验。
AI.method: 个案报告。患者植入S-ICD后体重显著增加，因除颤阻抗升高在发生器更换时重新评估，发现囊袋裂开、脂肪嵌入和发生器浅表化；因纤维化无法通过简单牵引移动胸骨旁导线，遂行胸肌下发生器重新定位。主要观察指标为PRAETORIAN评分和除颤阻抗，并测试除颤效果。
AI.result: 胸肌下发生器重新定位后PRAETORIAN评分改善，除颤阻抗下降；但随后阻抗再次升至130Ω，以65J能量除颤成功。摘要未报告具体PRAETORIAN评分数值及阻抗下降幅度。
AI.conclusion: S-ICD几何应视为动态变量，尤其在体重显著变化后需重新评估；胸肌下发生器重新定位可作为晚期几何失效的补救措施，但阻抗可能再次升高，需密切监测。摘要为单例报告，结论推广受限。

summary_zh: S-ICD 的疗效取决于心外电击向量几何构型。我们报告一例在体重显著增加后出现的迟发性肥胖相关几何构型恶化。电击阻抗升高促使在更换脉冲发生器时重新评估，发现囊袋裂开、脂肪组织嵌入以及脉冲发生器位置过浅。由于纤维化导致无法通过简单牵引使胸骨旁导线移位，将脉冲发生器重新放置于前锯肌下改善了 PRAETORIAN 评分和电击阻抗。尽管随后阻抗升至 130 Ω，65 J 电击仍成功除颤。S-ICD 的几何构型应被视为动态变化，尤其是在体型发生重大改变之后。

title: Inappropriate ICD Therapy Due to Double Counting from a Dislodged Defibrillator Lead.
Potential harms to rescuers during cardiac arrest response and resuscitation: a scoping review.
authors: International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation Basic Life Support Task Force†
International Liaison Committee on Resuscitation Basic Life Support Task Force
summary:
BACKGROUND: Rescuer safety during cardiac arrest response and resuscitation is an important consideration that may influence willingness to intervene. This scoping review identifies potential unintentional harms to rescuers responding to cardiac arrest and performing resuscitation.

METHODS: This scoping review was reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR guidelines. We searched EMBASE, Medline, and Cochrane from inception to June 16, 2026, including all human studies reporting physical harms during cardiac arrest response or resuscitation (compressions, ventilation, defibrillation). Two investigators screened studies and extracted data. Synthesis was guided by Joanna Briggs Institute methods, with narrative synthesis by harm category.

RESULTS: Twenty studies were included: sixteen provided direct evidence from cardiac arrest or resuscitation, and four provided indirect evidence from elective cardioversion. Of the direct-evidence studies, nine examined infection transmission during CPR, two evaluated electrical exposure from implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) during CPR, two reported physical injuries en route to arrest, and three documented drowning during rescue. Infection transmission rates varied by pathogen but were mitigated by personal protective equipment (PPE). CPR near implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs) showed potential for higher leakage. In the four indirect-evidence studies, current leakage to rescuers during external shocks delivered for elective cardioversion remained below safe thresholds. One study reported minor injuries from incorrect opening of locked AED cabinets, and another found that injuries en route to patients were rare (<0.7%). Rescue-related drowning fatalities ranged from 0.02 to 0.08 per 100,000 population annually.

CONCLUSIONS: This scoping review suggests harms to rescuers during response or resuscitation are rare. Fatal harms have been reported during water rescue. Minor harms include unsafe AED removal, current leakage during ICD shock delivery, performing CPR without appropriate PPE, and minor injuries en route to a cardiac arrest. Indirect evidence from elective cardioversion suggests external defibrillation poses minimal electrical risk.

AI.tldr: 该范围综述纳入20项研究，提示心脏骤停施救过程中施救者受到的伤害总体罕见，但水上救援可发生致死性伤害，其他轻微伤害包括AED取出不当、ICD放电漏电及未使用PPE行CPR等。
AI.motivation: 施救者安全是影响旁观者是否愿意在心脏骤停时出手干预的重要因素，但既往证据分散，缺乏对施救过程中潜在非故意伤害的系统梳理，本研究旨在明确这些伤害的类型与发生情况。
AI.method: 按照PRISMA-ScR指南开展范围综述，检索EMBASE、Medline和Cochrane数据库（自建库至2026年6月16日），纳入所有报告心脏骤停响应或复苏（胸外按压、通气、除颤）过程中施救者身体伤害的人体研究；由两名研究者独立筛选与提取数据，依据Joanna Briggs Institute方法按伤害类别进行叙述性综合。
AI.result: 共纳入20项研究，其中16项提供心脏骤停或复苏的直接证据，4项来自择期心脏电复律的间接证据。直接证据中，9项评估CPR期间感染传播，2项评估CPR期间ICD的电暴露，2项报告赶赴现场途中的身体损伤，3项记录救援中溺水。感染传播率因病原体而异，个人防护装备（PPE）可降低风险；在ICD附近行CPR存在漏电增高可能。4项间接证据显示，择期电复律体外放电时施救者漏电流低于安全阈值。一项研究报道错误打开锁定的AED柜导致轻微伤，另一项发现赶赴患者途中受伤罕见（<0.7%）。救援相关溺水死亡率为每年每10万人0.02至0.08例。
AI.conclusion: 施救者在心脏骤停响应或复苏中受到的伤害总体罕见，水上救援可发生致死性伤害；轻微伤害包括AED取出不当、ICD放电时漏电、未使用适当PPE行CPR及赶赴现场途中轻伤。择期电复律的间接证据提示体外除颤的电风险很小。上述结果支持在鼓励旁观者施救的同时加强PPE与安全操作培训，但证据多为叙述性综合、缺乏对照设计，且部分伤害数据来自间接人群，需进一步前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏骤停响应与复苏过程中的施救者安全是一个重要考量，可能影响施救意愿。本范围综述旨在识别响应心脏骤停并实施复苏的施救者可能遭受的意外伤害。

方法：本范围综述按照PRISMA-ScR指南进行报告。我们检索了EMBASE、Medline和Cochrane数据库，从建库至2026年6月16日，纳入所有报告心脏骤停响应或复苏（按压、通气、除颤）过程中身体伤害的人类研究。两名研究者筛选研究并提取数据。综合方法遵循Joanna Briggs研究所方法，按伤害类别进行叙述性综合。

结果：共纳入20项研究：16项提供来自心脏骤停或复苏的直接证据，4项提供来自择期心脏电复律的间接证据。在直接证据研究中，9项探讨了CPR期间的感染传播，2项评估了CPR期间植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）的电暴露，2项报告了前往骤停现场途中的身体损伤，3项记录了对溺水者的救援。感染传播率因病原体而异，但可通过个人防护装备（PPE）减轻。在植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）附近进行CPR显示出更高的漏电可能性。在4项间接证据研究中，择期心脏电复律期间外部电击对施救者的漏电流仍低于安全阈值。一项研究报告了因错误打开上锁的AED柜子而导致的轻微伤害，另一项研究发现前往患者途中的伤害罕见（<0.7%）。救援相关的溺水死亡率为每年每10万人口0.02至0.08例。

结论：本范围综述提示，响应或复苏过程中对施救者的伤害罕见。水上救援中曾报告致命伤害。轻微伤害包括不安全地取下AED、ICD电击放电期间的漏电、未使用适当PPE进行CPR以及前往心脏骤停现场途中的轻微伤害。来自择期心脏电复律的间接证据提示，外部除颤带来的电风险极小。

title: [A deep learning-based method for rapid reconstruction and prediction of electromagnetic exposure in pacemaker patients].
summary: Microwave ovens and other electromagnetic devices may leak electromagnetic fields, which can interfere with implanted cardiac pacemakers in patients. The traditional finite element method (FEM) is time-consuming and difficult to meet the needs of rapid risk assessment. This paper proposes a fast reconstruction and prediction method for electromagnetic exposure based on 3D U-Net to predict the electromagnetic exposure in patients with implanted cardiac pacemakers caused by microwave oven leakage under random scenarios. First, the FEM was used to simulate the thoracic electric field, specific absorption rate (SAR), and induced electric field in the pacemaker under different electromagnetic exposure conditions, and a sample set was constructed after preprocessing. Second, the 3D U-Net model was trained with spatial coordinates, microwave oven power, distance between the human body and the microwave oven, and oven door gap as inputs, and the thoracic electric field, SAR, and induced electric field in the pacemaker as labels. The results showed that the predicted thoracic electric field, SAR, and induced electric field in the pacemaker were in good agreement with the FEM simulation results. On the validation set, the relative error rates of the thoracic electric field, SAR, and induced electric field in the pacemaker were 0.78%, 0.72%, and 0.94%, respectively. The prediction time for a single case was only 0.93 s. This method can serve as an effective supplement to traditional numerical simulation and provides a new approach for rapid assessment of electromagnetic exposure in patients with implanted cardiac pacemakers.

AI.tldr: 基于3D U-Net的深度学习模型可快速预测起搏器患者微波炉泄漏电磁暴露，验证集相对误差<1%，单例预测仅0.93秒。
AI.motivation: 微波炉等电磁设备泄漏的电磁场可能干扰植入式心脏起搏器，传统有限元法耗时难以满足快速风险评估需求，亟需快速重建与预测方法。
AI.method: 研究采用3D U-Net深度学习模型，输入空间坐标、微波炉功率、人体与微波炉距离及炉门缝隙，输出胸部电场、SAR和起搏器内诱导电场。首先用有限元法模拟不同暴露条件下的电磁场构建样本集，经预处理后训练模型。摘要未报告样本量及训练/验证集划分细节。
AI.result: 验证集上预测的胸部电场、SAR和起搏器内诱导电场与有限元模拟结果高度一致，相对误差分别为0.78%、0.72%和0.94%；单例预测时间仅0.93秒。摘要未报告置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该深度学习方法可作为传统数值模拟的有效补充，为植入起搏器患者电磁暴露的快速评估提供新途径，有望提升临床风险评估效率。局限性包括样本量未报告、模型泛化性需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 微波炉及其他电磁设备可能泄漏电磁场，从而对植入心脏起搏器的患者造成干扰。传统的有限元方法（FEM）耗时较长，难以满足快速风险评估的需求。本文提出一种基于3D U-Net的电磁暴露快速重建与预测方法，用于预测随机场景下微波炉泄漏对植入心脏起搏器患者造成的电磁暴露。首先，采用FEM模拟不同电磁暴露条件下胸腔电场、起搏器内的比吸收率（SAR）和感应电场，经预处理后构建样本集。其次，以空间坐标、微波炉功率、人体与微波炉的距离以及炉门缝隙作为输入，以胸腔电场、SAR和起搏器内感应电场作为标签，训练3D U-Net模型。结果表明，预测的胸腔电场、SAR和起搏器内感应电场与FEM模拟结果吻合良好。在验证集上，胸腔电场、SAR和起搏器内感应电场的相对误差率分别为0.78%、0.72%和0.94%。单例预测时间仅需0.93 s。该方法可作为传统数值模拟的有效补充，为植入心脏起搏器患者的电磁暴露快速评估提供了新途径。

title: From Monogenic Variants to Polygenic Risk Scores in Inherited Cardiomyopathies: Clinical Utility, Ancestry Gaps, and Future Implementation in Arab Populations.
summary: Inherited cardiomyopathies are major causes of heart failure, malignant ventricular arrhythmia, and sudden cardiac death, and they require lifelong surveillance of affected individuals and clinically at-risk relatives. Their clinical genetics has traditionally been organised around rare monogenic pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants, especially in sarcomeric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), titin-related and other sarcomeric forms of dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), nuclear-envelope DCM, and desmosomal arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM). This model remains indispensable, but it is incomplete: it does not fully explain genotype-negative disease, variable penetrance, age of onset, disease severity, or discordant phenotypes within the same family. Polygenic risk scores (PRS), which aggregate the weighted effects of common variants, offer a second layer of inherited susceptibility that may refine the interpretation of rare variants and borderline phenotypes. Current evidence is strongest for HCM, increasingly important for DCM, and still weak for ACM and restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM). The central limitation is equity and transferability. Most cardiomyopathy PRS discovery, calibration, and validation have been performed in European-ancestry datasets. At the same time, Arab and Middle Eastern populations remain underrepresented in GWAS, reference allele-frequency databases, longitudinal cardiac imaging resources, and clinical utility studies. Direct importation of European PRS into Arab cardiovascular genetics would therefore risk miscalibration, variant misclassification, false reassurance, overdiagnosis, and inappropriate counseling. This critical review evaluates PRS evidence across HCM, DCM, ACM, RCM, and related inherited cardiac diseases; explains why PRS is not a diagnostic test or replacement for monogenic testing; and proposes a phased Arab implementation framework based on local discovery cohorts, whole-genome sequencing, ancestry-aware calibration, family-based penetrance studies, harmonized imaging phenotypes, prospective outcome tracking, genetic counseling pathways, and governance safeguards. The future is not monogenic versus polygenic risk; it is integrated genomic risk, implemented only when clinically validated and equitable.

AI.tldr: 综述指出遗传性心肌病多基因风险评分证据在HCM最强、DCM渐增、ACM/RCM弱，欧洲数据直接移植至阿拉伯人群存在校准与公平性风险，需本地化分阶段实施。
AI.motivation: 遗传性心肌病是心衰、恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死的重要原因，传统单基因模型无法完全解释基因型阴性、外显不全、发病年龄和表型差异。多基因风险评分（PRS）可补充遗传易感性，但现有PRS主要基于欧洲 ancestry 数据，阿拉伯和中东人群在GWAS、等位基因频率数据库和临床效用研究中代表性不足，直接移植存在误校准、变异误分类和过度诊断等风险。
AI.method: 本文为批判性综述，评估PRS在肥厚型心肌病（HCM）、扩张型心肌病（DCM）、致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）、限制型心肌病（RCM）及相关遗传性心脏病中的证据，阐明PRS不是诊断工具或单基因检测的替代，并提出基于本地发现队列、全基因组测序、ancestry-aware校准、家系外显率研究、统一影像表型、前瞻性结局追踪、遗传咨询路径和治理保障的分阶段阿拉伯人群实施框架。摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入研究数量或定量合成方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。定性总结显示：PRS证据在HCM最强，在DCM日益重要，在ACM和RCM仍较弱；主要局限为公平性和可移植性，因多数心肌病PRS的发现、校准和验证均在欧洲 ancestry 数据集中完成，而阿拉伯和中东人群在GWAS、参考等位基因频率数据库、纵向心脏影像资源和临床效用研究中代表性不足。
AI.conclusion: 未来方向不是单基因与多基因风险的对立，而是整合基因组风险，且仅在临床验证和公平可及的前提下实施。对电生理实践而言，PRS目前不能替代单基因检测或用于诊断，临床使用需谨慎解读，尤其在非欧洲 ancestry 人群中；需建立本地队列和ancestry-aware校准，避免误校准和不当咨询。局限性为综述未提供定量证据，实施框架尚待前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 遗传性心肌病是心力衰竭、恶性室性心律失常和心源性猝死的主要原因，需要对患者及临床高危亲属进行终身监测。其临床遗传学传统上围绕罕见的单基因致病性或可能致病性变异展开，尤其是在肌节性肥厚型心肌病（HCM）、Titin相关及其他肌节性形式的扩张型心肌病（DCM）、核膜DCM和桥粒性致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）中。这一模型仍然不可或缺，但并不完整：它不能完全解释基因型阴性疾病、可变外显率、发病年龄、疾病严重程度或同一家族内的不一致表型。多基因风险评分（PRS）通过聚合常见变异的加权效应，提供了遗传易感性的第二层信息，可能有助于细化罕见变异和临界表型的解读。目前证据在HCM中最强，在DCM中日益重要，而在ACM和限制型心肌病（RCM）中仍然较弱。核心局限在于公平性和可转移性。大多数心肌病PRS的发现、校准和验证均在欧洲血统数据集中进行。与此同时，阿拉伯和中东人群在GWAS、参考等位基因频率数据库、纵向心脏影像资源和临床效用研究中仍然代表性不足。因此，将欧洲PRS直接引入阿拉伯心血管遗传学将面临校准错误、变异错误分类、虚假 reassurance、过度诊断和不恰当咨询的风险。本批判性综述评估了HCM、DCM、ACM、RCM及相关遗传性心脏病中的PRS证据；解释了为何PRS不是诊断测试或单基因检测的替代品；并提出了一个分阶段的阿拉伯实施框架，基于本地发现队列、全基因组测序、祖先感知校准、基于家族的外显率研究、统一影像表型、前瞻性结局追踪、遗传咨询路径和治理保障。未来不是单基因与多基因风险的对立；而是整合基因组风险，仅在临床验证且公平的情况下实施。

title: Beyond Conventional Autopsy: Recent Advances in Molecular Autopsy for Sudden Cardiac Death Investigation.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) is a leading cause of unexpected mortality worldwide and represents a major challenge in pathology, especially when conventional autopsy fails to identify a definitive cause of death. In these cases, molecular autopsy (MA) has emerged as a valuable diagnostic approach, enabling the identification of pathogenic genetic variants associated with inherited cardiomyopathies, channelopathies, and other cardiovascular diseases. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the current role of MA in the investigation of SCD, highlighting recent advances in postmortem genetic testing and their impact on forensic practice. The evolution of sequencing technologies, from targeted gene panels to whole-exome and whole-genome sequencing, as well as new long-read sequencing approaches, is discussed. Emphasis is placed on the interpretation of genetic variants according to current international guidelines, the integration of molecular findings with autopsy, histopathological, and toxicological investigations, and the importance of multidisciplinary collaboration between forensic pathologists, molecular geneticists, cardiologists, and genetic counselors. We also examine current challenges, including variants of uncertain significance, limited genotype-phenotype correlation, ethical considerations, and the need for standardized international protocols. Finally, we explore prospects, including multi-omics technologies, artificial intelligence-assisted variant interpretation, and improved data sharing initiatives, which may improve diagnostic accuracy and facilitate clinical translation. In addition to determining cause of death, MA has become an essential tool for identifying at-risk relatives through cascade screening, thus extending the role of forensic genetics from postmortem diagnosis to preventive cardiovascular medicine.

AI.tldr: 分子尸检可识别常规尸检阴性的心脏性猝死病例中的致病基因变异，并通过级联筛查识别高危亲属，将法医遗传学延伸至预防性心血管医学。
AI.motivation: 心脏性猝死（SCD）是全球意外死亡的主要原因，常规尸检常无法明确病因，分子尸检（MA）成为识别遗传性心肌病和离子通道病相关致病变异的重要工具，但既往证据在检测技术选择、变异解读和临床转化方面仍存在缺口。
AI.method: 本文为综述，系统总结MA在SCD调查中的作用，涵盖测序技术从靶向基因panel到全外显子/全基因组测序及长读长测序的演进，强调按国际指南解读基因变异、整合尸检/组织病理/毒理结果及多学科协作，并讨论不确定意义变异、基因型-表型关联有限、伦理和标准化协议等挑战。摘要未报告具体样本量、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；定性指出MA可识别与遗传性心肌病、离子通道病等相关的致病变异，并通过级联筛查识别高危亲属，但受限于不确定意义变异和基因型-表型关联有限。
AI.conclusion: MA已成为SCD调查和亲属级联筛查的关键工具，将法医遗传学从死后诊断拓展至预防性心血管医学；未来需标准化国际协议、多组学与人工智能辅助变异解读及数据共享，以提升诊断准确性和临床转化。摘要未报告具体局限性数据。

summary_zh: 心源性猝死（SCD）是全球意外死亡的主要原因之一，也是病理学中的重大挑战，尤其是当常规尸检未能确定明确的死亡原因时。在这些情况下，分子尸检（MA）已成为一种有价值的诊断方法，能够识别与遗传性心肌病、离子通道病和其他心血管疾病相关的致病性遗传变异。本综述全面概述了MA目前在SCD调查中的作用，重点介绍了死后基因检测的最新进展及其对法医实践的影响。讨论了测序技术的演变，从靶向基因面板到全外显子组和全基因组测序，以及新的长读长测序方法。重点在于根据当前国际指南解释遗传变异，将分子发现与尸检、组织病理学和毒理学调查相结合，以及法医病理学家、分子遗传学家、心脏病学家和遗传咨询师之间多学科合作的重要性。我们还探讨了当前的挑战，包括意义不明的变异、有限的基因型-表型相关性、伦理考虑以及标准化国际协议的需求。最后，我们展望了前景，包括多组学技术、人工智能辅助变异解释和改进的数据共享计划，这些可能提高诊断准确性并促进临床转化。除了确定死亡原因外，MA已成为通过级联筛查识别高危亲属的重要工具，从而将法医遗传学的作用从死后诊断扩展到预防性心血管医学。

title: Impact of aging on catecholaminergic ventricular arrhythmia and cardiac transcriptome of cardiac calsequestrin null mice.
summary: Catecholamine-induced polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is associated typically with mutations in Ryanodine Receptor type 2 (RYR2) and cardiac Calsequestrin (CASQ2) genes. RyR2 and CASQ2 along with membrane proteins, junctin and triadin, constitute the Ca2+ release unit in the junctional sarcoplasmic reticulum in mammalian cardiomyocytes. Mouse models lacking Casq2 gene phenocopy CPVT and have been used to study CPVT pathophysiology and to identify novel therapies. Here, we analyze roles of normal aging for the development of cardiac dysfunctions of Casq2-null mice. We show that aging intensifies the disease phenotype. Age-dependent changes in triadin but not in RyR2 or junctin correlate with a more severe CPVT phenotype. We also examine transcriptomes at 1 month and 2 years of age. We identify 583 genes whose expression is dependent on Casq2 genotype with enrichment for genes associated with calcium handling and transport, sarcomere structures, extracellular matrix, and natriuretic peptide signaling. Age-stratified analyses identified 76 genes that were dysregulated only in aged mice and 22 genes that were dysregulated only in young animals.

AI.tldr: 衰老会加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，且triadin表达随年龄变化与表型严重程度相关，转录组分析揭示年龄依赖的基因表达改变。
AI.motivation: CPVT通常与RYR2和CASQ2基因突变相关，Casq2缺失小鼠是研究CPVT病理生理和治疗的重要模型，但正常衰老对该模型心脏功能障碍的影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 研究使用Casq2缺失小鼠模型，分析衰老对CPVT表型的影响，检测triadin、RyR2和junctin的表达变化，并对1月龄和2岁小鼠心脏进行转录组分析，鉴定基因型依赖和年龄依赖的差异表达基因。
AI.result: 衰老加重CPVT表型；triadin的年龄依赖性变化与更严重的CPVT表型相关，而RyR2和junctin无此关联。转录组分析鉴定出583个基因表达依赖Casq2基因型，富集于钙处理与转运、肌节结构、细胞外基质和利钠肽信号通路；年龄分层分析发现76个基因仅在老年小鼠中失调，22个基因仅在年轻动物中失调。
AI.conclusion: 衰老通过triadin相关机制加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，并伴随年龄特异性的心脏转录组改变，提示衰老是CPVT进展的重要因素，未来研究需考虑年龄对疾病表型和治疗反应的影响。

summary_zh: 儿茶酚胺诱导的多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）通常与Ryanodine受体2型（RYR2）和心脏Calsequestrin（CASQ2）基因的突变相关。RyR2和CASQ2与膜蛋白junctin和triadin一起，构成哺乳动物心肌细胞连接肌浆网中的Ca2+释放单元。缺乏Casq2基因的小鼠模型可表型模拟CPVT，并已被用于研究CPVT的病理生理学和识别新疗法。在此，我们分析正常衰老对Casq2缺失小鼠心脏功能障碍发展的作用。我们显示衰老加剧了疾病表型。triadin而非RyR2或junctin的年龄依赖性变化与更严重的CPVT表型相关。我们还检查了1个月和2岁时的心脏转录组。我们识别了583个基因，其表达依赖于Casq2基因型，富集于与钙处理和转运、肌节结构、细胞外基质和利钠肽信号相关的基因。年龄分层分析识别了76个仅在老年小鼠中失调的基因和22个仅在年轻动物中失调的基因。

title: Sinus Bradycardia Limiting Beta-Blockade in Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia: Atrial Leadless Pacing.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Beta-blockade is the cornerstone of therapy in catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT), but coexisting sinus node dysfunction can prevent adequate dosing.

CASE SUMMARY: A woman aged in her late 20s presented with exertional syncope. She had profound sinus bradycardia and reproducible exercise-induced multiform ventricular ectopy in a structurally normal heart, supporting a diagnosis of CPVT, later confirmed with genetic testing (pathogenic RYR2 variant). Resting heart rates in the low 30s precluded beta-blocker initiation. After shared decision-making in which she declined transvenous leads, an atrial leadless pacemaker was implanted, permitting up-titration of nadolol with flecainide and deferral of an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.

DISCUSSION: Sinus node dysfunction is recognized in CPVT but is seldom framed as a modifiable obstacle to guideline-directed therapy. Treating the bradycardia allowed medical therapy to be maximized before device therapy, consistent with consensus recommendations.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Bradycardia that limits beta-blockade in CPVT is a pacing problem rather than drug intolerance.

AI.tldr: 一例CPVT女性患者因严重窦性心动过缓无法启用β受体阻滞剂，植入心房无导线起搏器后成功上调nadolol剂量并联合氟卡尼，暂缓ICD植入。
AI.motivation: β受体阻滞剂是CPVT治疗的基石，但合并窦房结功能障碍常限制其剂量上调，既往文献多将其视为合并症而非可干预的治疗障碍，缺乏通过起搏解决该问题的病例证据。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为20余岁女性，运动性晕厥，静息心率30次/分左右，运动诱发多形性室性早搏，基因检测证实致病性RYR2变异，确诊CPVT。因患者拒绝经静脉导线，经共同决策植入心房无导线起搏器，随后上调nadolol并联合氟卡尼。终点为β受体阻滞剂剂量上调及ICD植入的延迟。摘要未报告统计方法。
AI.result: 植入心房无导线起搏器后，成功上调nadolol剂量并联合氟卡尼，ICD植入得以暂缓。摘要未报告具体心率变化、药物剂量及随访时间等数值。
AI.conclusion: CPVT中限制β受体阻滞剂使用的窦性心动过缓应视为起搏可解决的节律问题而非药物不耐受，心房无导线起搏器可作为拒绝经静脉导线患者的选择，有助于先最大化药物治疗再评估器械治疗。本例为单例报告，结论外推需谨慎，长期疗效及安全性尚待验证。

summary_zh:
背景：β受体阻滞是儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）治疗的基石，但合并存在的窦房结功能障碍可能妨碍充分给药。

病例摘要：一名20多岁的女性因劳力性晕厥就诊。她存在显著的窦性心动过缓，并在结构正常的心脏中可重复出现运动诱发的多形性室性早搏，支持CPVT的诊断，后经基因检测（致病性RYR2变异）证实。静息心率在30次/分低值，妨碍了β受体阻滞剂的启用。经过共同决策，患者拒绝经静脉导线，遂植入心房无导线起搏器，从而允许将纳多洛尔与氟卡尼上调至目标剂量，并推迟了植入式心律转复除颤器的植入。

讨论：窦房结功能障碍在CPVT中已被认识，但很少被视为指南指导治疗的可改变障碍。治疗心动过缓使得在器械治疗前能够最大化药物治疗，这与共识建议一致。

要点：在CPVT中限制β受体阻滞剂使用的心动过缓是一个起搏问题，而非药物不耐受。

title: Research trends and hotspot analysis of sudden cardiac death in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: A bibliometric analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is the most common genetic heart disease and a leading cause of sudden cardiac death. This study aims to map the research landscape of Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy -related sudden cardiac death over the past 2 decades using bibliometric methods.

METHODS: We performed a bibliometric analysis of 712 publications retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (2005-2025). Using Cite Space, we examined publication trends, collaboration networks, co-citation patterns, and keyword dynamics.

RESULTS: Annual publication output rose markedly, with pronounced accelerations after the 2014 European Society of Cardiology and 2020 American heart association/American College of Cardiology guidelines. The United States led in productivity (203 publications) and network centrality (0.40), while China ranked second in output (123 publications) but exhibited limited international collaboration (centrality = 0.01). Co‑citation analysis indicated that clinical guidelines and risk‑prediction models form the field' score knowledge base, and five of the ten most cited references were international guidelines. Keyword analysis defined 4 principal thematic clusters disease entity, clinical outcomes, imaging biomarkers, and risk stratification and documented a shift from early mechanistic studies to multimodal risk prediction, followed more recently by artificial intelligence-driven models and targeted pharmacological therapies (e.g., mavacamten).

CONCLUSION: This study provides a systematic, data-driven overview of the knowledge structure and evolutionary trends in Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy-related sudden Cardiac death research. The findings underscore the field' s guideline-driven character, document the rise of AI-based risk stratification, and describe a paradigm shift toward disease-modifying therapies, offering actionable insights for prioritizing future research and informing clinical decision-making.

title: Capture Verification in Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing: Reporting Gaps and a Practical Framework.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) comprises two physiologically distinct interventions: left bundle branch pacing (LBBP), which captures the conduction system, and left ventricular septal pacing (LVSP), which captures septal myocardium only. How consistently studies document which was achieved is unknown.

METHODS: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Europe PMC, and OpenAlex to June 21, 2026, and audited the eligible studies against ten prespecified reporting items, four primary and six supporting. Screening and extraction were independent and in duplicate. A continuous 0-100 score, threshold sensitivity analyses, and stratification were post hoc.

RESULTS: An explicit capture definition was reported in 43 of 46 studies (93%), a numerator with denominator in 32 (70%), and outcomes by capture status in 18 (39%). LBBP, LVSP, and indeterminate capture were separated in one study (2%). Independent adjudication was described in two (4%), follow-up reassessment in seven (15%), and programmed output in three (7%). No study reported all four primary items with at least four supporting items; the median score was 43.3. Across seven alternative thresholds, six studies (13%) qualified at most. Studies from 2024 to 2026 scored higher than those from 2020 to 2023 (median 55.0 vs. 36.7; p = 0.015), although reporting of adjudication did not improve and reporting of reassessment only marginally. These comparisons were exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity.

CONCLUSIONS: In LBBAP studies with extractable capture information, capture verification is reported inconsistently and is often not separated from procedural success. We propose a reporting framework and an exploratory, author-derived capture-confidence score.

AI.tldr: 在46项可提取夺获信息的左束支区域起搏研究中，夺获验证报告严重不一致，仅1项研究区分LBBP、LVSP与不确定夺获，中位报告评分43.3分。
AI.motivation: 左束支区域起搏包含两种生理学不同的干预：夺获传导系统的左束支起搏（LBBP）和仅夺获室间隔心肌的左室间隔起搏（LVSP）。两者临床意义不同，但既往研究是否一致地记录实际达到哪种夺获尚不清楚，这一证据缺口影响对LBBAP疗效与安全性的解读。
AI.method: 文献审计研究。检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Europe PMC和OpenAlex至2026年6月21日，纳入46项可提取夺获信息的合格研究。依据10项预设报告条目（4项主要、6项支持性）进行独立双人筛选与提取。采用0-100连续评分，并进行阈值敏感性分析和分层分析（均为事后分析）。
AI.result: 明确报告夺获定义者43/46（93%），报告分子与分母者32/46（70%），按夺获状态报告结局者18/46（39%）。仅1项研究（2%）区分LBBP、LVSP和不确定夺获；描述独立裁定者2项（4%），随访再评估7项（15%），报告程控输出3项（7%）。无研究同时报告全部4项主要条目及至少4项支持条目，中位评分43.3分；在7种替代阈值下，最多仅6项研究（13%）达标。2024-2026年研究评分高于2020-2023年（中位55.0 vs 36.7，p=0.015），但裁定报告未改善，再评估报告仅轻微改善；上述比较为探索性且未校正多重比较。
AI.conclusion: 在可提取夺获信息的LBBAP研究中，夺获验证报告不一致，且常未与手术成功分开报告。作者提出一套报告框架及探索性、由作者衍生的夺获置信度评分，以规范未来研究。该研究为文献审计而非患者层面研究，评分与阈值分析为事后探索性，结论需前瞻性验证；对电生理实践而言，提示需在LBBAP术中及随访中明确区分LBBP与LVSP并标准化报告。
